invariant: When a local development server is configured or detected for the active mission, it must remain supervised and healthy for the duration of mutable work and before completion.
requirements: Start the guardian daemon when a dev server is detected or configured.
Treat health loss as an operational incident and attempt bounded-backoff recovery automatically.
Do not claim DONE while the required localhost endpoint is unhealthy.
Do not kill an unrelated process solely to free a configured port; surface a conflict unless the process is guardian-owned.
Record guardian state and health evidence.
